svg.title: Rudraksh Chaudhry
svg.text: I build AI products end to end: retrieval and
agent pipelines, search, and the full-stack apps
around them. Recent work includes an
open-world game on 147k real places in San
Francisco and a conference planner whose
recommendations are graph walks. Before that:
retrieval-augmented generation, hybrid search, LLM agents, knowledge graphs
Figure 1: How I build. Each stage names the parts used in recent projects; the shaded box
Retrieval in Spirits fuses the BM25 and kNN rankings of each place d by reciprocal rank
fusion, summing over both rankings r:
An open-world pixel game on the real map of San
Francisco. 147k places from city open data
become spirits you meet and befriend.
recommendation is a walk through one FalkorDB
graph, and the app shows you the walk.
falkordb · mcp agent · openai · bright data
Crop schedules from an ML model and live
weather, for farmers planning a season.
